instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a full shot of a lakeside park in autumn. On the right, the man in the brown cardigan (R1) leans against a tree trunk, looking down at his hands. On the left, the red-haired woman in the white turtleneck (R2) stands facing him, looking down at the leaves they are sharing. They stand close together, with the man holding out yellow leaves in his hands as the woman reaches towards them. The background shows a soft-focus lake. The lighting is soft natural daylight, emphasizing a warm autumn color palette.
